quick_ref.Theme: Unit 1: Identity & Environment — Hero Gear Check

methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Singular Existence in Context
content: Problem: Students often confuse identifying objects ("This is a pen") with stating their existence or location ("There is a pen").

Solution: Week 7 explicitly introduces "There is a/an..." using the highly tangible context of a student's backpack. By combining this with the prepositions learned in Week 6 (in, on, under), students learn to accurately describe the existence and location of single objects.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: Pull-out oral tasks (teacher does these with 1–2 students while class works):
S1 pull-out: Give the student a real backpack with items inside. Ask: "What is in your backpack?" Student pulls out an item: "There is a ruler."
S2 pull-out: Place an eraser on the desk. Ask: "What is on the desk?" Student: "There is an eraser on the desk."
S3 pull-out: Student reads S3 VC script aloud → teacher notes pronunciation errors (especially "There is an") → recasts.
Materials needed: Print 2 copies of Card A and 2 copies of Card B.
Give Card A to Student A, Card B to Student B.
Students do not show their cards. They ask each other the target question to fill in the missing information.
Students produce complete sentences together to verify answers.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W7: backpack, pencil, pen, ruler, eraser
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (backpack, pencil, pen, ruler, eraser) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: "There is a/an..." (Singular existence)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: "There is a/an..." (Singular existence).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Identity & Environment — Inside My Backpack"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Identity & Environment — Inside My Backpack".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (backpack, pencil, pen, ruler, eraser usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
